title: Wiemer waitlist (v2)
description: A grey sign-up band: centred accent tag, a very large heading whose letters rise in, a short paragraph, then a form card (grey price box in mono, email field, consent, full-width accent button) centred over a field of big pale perforation dots that darken under the pointer.
notes: the dots show from lg up; phones get the heading and the card
posts to `action`; wire validation and sending in your app
name: wiemer-v2-waitlist

props.name: id
props.description: anchor id, so links like #reserve land here

props.name: text
props.description: two or three centred lines under it

props.name: formTitle
props.description: the heading inside the form card

props.name: prices
props.description: the prices shown in the grey box in the card

props.name: fields
props.description: the form's fields (usually just an email)

props.name: consent
props.description: the consent line next to the checkbox

props.name: dotRows
props.description: rows of dots behind the card on desktop (default 9)
